colorA.description: Color of fresh trails (sRGB hex, decoded to linear).

colorB.description: Color trails transition to as they fade (sRGB hex, decoded to linear).

radius.description: Base radius of the trail stroke (×0.1 in UV units in the shader).

length.description: How long the trail persists; age rate = min(dt, 0.25) / max(0.1, length).

shrink.description: Stroke taper as it fades (0 = no taper, 1 = full taper).

softness.description: Edge softness (0 = crisp analytic edge, 1 = very soft).
